fields.description: The team this key spends for. Its Free flag, payload-log opt-in and credit verdict ride on the key to the gateway.
fields.label: Team

fields.description: The one geography this key works in; every gateway elsewhere answers 403. Left blank, it is the default Geography. Set once: its spend and rate counters live on that geography's store.
fields.label: Geography

fields.description: What this key may spend, cut out of the team's balance: the gateway refuses it at 402 once its spend reaches this. 0 until a limit is set, and the key is refused until then. Across the team's live keys, Σ (cap − spent) never exceeds the balance. Ignored while the team is Free.
fields.label: Cap (USD)

fields.description: What this key has been charged: priced by the pull from each billed drain, plus any correction from a resolved Credit Discrepancy.
fields.label: Spent (USD)

fields.description: Groups of this key's geography. A new key starts in the one marked default there.
fields.label: Model Groups

fields.description: Models this key may call on top of its groups'. A vendor model is its geography's doc.
fields.label: Allow

fields.description: Models this key may never call. Deny wins over everything — a group grant and a Public release both lose to it.
fields.label: Deny

fields.description: Counted on the gateway, per Gateway Store, for this key alone. A window resets on the UTC clock: top of the minute, the hour, midnight, the 1st. No rows = uncapped.
fields.label: Limits
